description: Type Apigee's missing-resource answer. Apigee returns HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'Permission denied on resource "organizations/..." (or it may not exist)' for a resource (or organization) that does not exist, so it surfaced as the generic Forbidden and callers could not tell a missing resource from a real permission error. IAM denials name the permission ('Permission \'apigee.x.y\' denied on resource ...') and stay Forbidden.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The Apigee resource (or its organization) does not exist. Apigee answers HTTP 403 'Permission denied on resource "organizations/..." (or it may not exist)' instead of 404.
